description: This file defines the HomeFragment class, which represents the main home screen for an Android TV app. It manages layout components such as a hero banner carousel, 'Continue Watching', and 'TV Channels' rails, all with focus and navigation logic tailored for remote control usage. It leverages ViewModel for data fetching and state management, integrates Compose for the top navigation bar, and handles auto-scrolling and focus routing.

classes.name: HomeFragment
classes.description: Main fragment managing the home screen layout, focus, navigation, hero banner, and data loading.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ViewModel and repository.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Constructs the view hierarchy, including Compose view for top navigation, hero banner, and content rails.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Sets initial focus, observes ViewModel states, triggers data loads.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Restores focus and resumes auto-scrolling.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Pauses auto-scrolling.

methods.name: observeViewModelStates
methods.description: Observes LiveData for content updates and errors.

methods.name: showContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for 'Continue Watching' rail.

methods.name: hideContinueWatchingLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for 'Continue Watching' rail.

methods.name: showTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Displays loading indicator for 'TV Channels' section.

methods.name: hideTvChannelsLoading
methods.description: Hides loading indicator for 'TV Channels'.

methods.name: updateContinueWatchingRail
methods.description: Populates 'Continue Watching' section with data.

methods.name: updateTvChannelsRail
methods.description: Populates 'TV Channels' section with data.

methods.name: addComposeTopNavBar
methods.description: Adds and configures the compose-based top navigation bar that manages focus and initial interaction.

methods.name: setupHeroBanner
methods.description: Initializes the hero carousel with auto-scroll and focus behavior.

methods.name: startHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Begins periodic auto-scrolling of the hero banner.

methods.name: stopHeroAutoScroll
methods.description: Stops auto-scrolling.

methods.name: setupContinueWatchingSection
methods.description: Configures the 'Continue Watching' horizontal list section.

methods.name: setupTvChannelsSection
methods.description: Configures the 'TV Channels' horizontal list section.

methods.name: setRailsFocusable
methods.description: Enables or disables focus participation for content rails, gating focus until explicitly enabled.

methods.name: dpToPx
methods.description: Utility function for converting dp units to pixels.
